name: Clay
description: Chalky handmade clay and painted plaster miniature
form: Soft thick rounded forms, slightly uneven molded edges, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Fine mottled sponge texture, matte surface, diffuse shadows, almost no specular shine
palette: Pale pistachio and lime main forms, seafoam or turquoise secondary parts, tiny orange-gold details

name: Flare
description: Flat vector illustration with restrained faux depth
form: Compact app-icon silhouette built from a few crisp geometric planes, mild three-quarter view
finish: Hard-edged light and dark color blocks, one narrow pale highlight, solid navy side faces; no reflective material
palette: Bright spring green dominates; deep navy defines depth; cyan and pale blue mark secondary details; yellow-orange only as a small accent

name: Zing
form: One familiar study object, simplified to its essential parts, with open white planes, a gentle tilt, and a steady, fine black contour
finish: Crisp near-monoline outlines and flat, untextured fills; use periwinkle only on a few side faces or components, with almost no shading or cast shadow
palette: White is the main field; periwinkle blue is the largest accent, with tiny lemon-yellow and bubblegum-pink marks

name: Gloss
form: Single compact, instantly readable object with a chunky rounded silhouette, simple frontal or shallow three-quarter view
finish: Smooth molded enamel, bold gold rims and bevels, a few broad white shine marks, clean bright highlights and soft short grounding shade
palette: Vivid golden yellow and amber dominate; royal blue and cyan form one or two large inset panels; tiny emerald accents only

name: Mist
form: A single simple UI object with a compact rounded silhouette and only a few essential parts; mostly front-facing, with just enough three-quarter depth to read its edge
finish: Opaque, softly airbrushed pale-cyan-to-mid-blue shading, brightest at the upper left and deeper blue at the lower right; one broad milky highlight and a restrained cool edge glow, no drawn contour
palette: Powder blue and white occupy nearly all the icon; cobalt is limited to lower edges and recesses, with coral red on one tiny functional control

name: Pebble
form: A sturdy everyday object with broad rounded masses, a compact readable silhouette, and a shallow three-quarter view that reveals one short side face
finish: Smooth soft-touch plastic with broad, restrained tonal shifts, clean rounded edges, one small controlled glint, and a short soft contact shadow only
palette: Cornflower or cobalt blue covers the main body; bright yellow marks a key functional part, orange is a pin-size accent, and navy stays in recesses and the small side face

name: Drift
form: Rounded simplified consumer object, visible functional feature, three-quarter view
finish: Smooth molded satin surface, broad gentle value shifts, sparse narrow highlights, no black stroke
palette: Vivid emerald or teal-green main body, sunny yellow hardware, cyan secondary panel, navy only inside recesses

name: Ink
form: One immediately recognizable everyday object, nearly frontal, drawn with a confident hand and slightly irregular outer contour; keep the silhouette bold and the interior spare
finish: Medium-weight black marker lines with subtle pressure variation, rounded line ends, a few short interior strokes, and at most two or three gesture marks; leave the interior white, using solid black only for a small opening or recess
palette: Black ink marks on a clean white field only

name: Cardboard
form: One compact object assembled from folded kraft-paper planes; make its box folds, layered edge thickness, tabs, slots, or one paper strap visibly structural, in a consistent three-quarter view
finish: Matte paper with restrained fiber grain; show corrugation only on exposed cut edges, a few clear fold seams, soft upper-left studio light, and a small contact shadow
palette: Warm kraft tan covers the broad planes; use muted indigo or teal on one or two panels, with a tiny coral or ochre paper fastener

name: Linepop
form: One cleanly constructed utility object, mostly white, in a mild three-quarter view; define its function with a small number of accurate interior divisions
finish: Crisp, even, fine near-black strokes with deliberate joins and no sketch wobble; leave most faces unfilled, adding at most one pale-blue side plane and a tiny sharp highlight
palette: White remains dominant; use neon lime on one focal control, a smaller lemon-yellow mark, and near-black only for fine contours

name: Glide
form: One familiar home or daily-use object built from two to five broad, softly rounded geometric shapes; use a mild three-quarter view only when needed to clarify its construction
finish: Solid matte color planes with crisp overlap boundaries and simple cutout shapes; no outline, surface texture, airbrush, or modeled light; one darker-green plane may indicate depth
palette: Deep emerald is the main shape; golden yellow marks one large functional component, while violet and cream appear only as tiny secondary accents

name: Nimble
description: Clear outlined commerce and utility icon
form: One functional household, retail, or electronic object with accurate recognizable parts, a compact silhouette, and a shallow three-quarter view
finish: Steady medium-fine black contours around flat faces; use broad royal-blue panels, open white face areas, and only a pale-blue side plane for depth, with no modeled gradient
palette: Royal blue and white share the main body; yellow marks one important control or fitting, and black is reserved for the consistent outline and small openings

name: Jot
form: One simple everyday object in a mostly frontal or mild three-quarter view; use fine, slightly imperfect contours and preserve generous white interior space
finish: Light black pen lines with subtle hand variation, only a few short construction marks, and sparse pale-gray grounding strokes; fill just one or two small planes with pale buttery yellow
palette: White paper and black linework dominate; pale butter yellow is the only fill and stays limited to a small functional or identifying area

name: Riso
form: Chunky editorial object made from overlapping graphic print plates, shallow three-quarter view
finish: Visible halftone dots and slight ink offset, paper grain, hard print edges, no volumetric shine
palette: Electric cobalt blue, acid yellow, aqua mint, lavender, small coral-red offset; cream-paper gaps

name: Marker
form: Object simplified to a strong contour and few interior marks, near-front view
finish: Thick slightly wobbly deep forest-green outline, flat marker-filled shapes with tiny uneven edges, almost no shadow
palette: Bubblegum pink and green dominate, with lemon yellow and pale aqua fills

name: Glass
form: Single simple object with a rounded, softly tinted solid-glass silhouette, front or shallow three-quarter view
finish: Smooth milky transparency, broad soft internal panes, one clear cyan rim highlight and a few pastel reflections; bright, airy light with a readable softly colored body
palette: Icy cyan and powder blue provide visible body color; tiny coral, peach or lemon reflections; generous white space

name: Watercolor
form: One familiar object with believable but simplified construction, arranged as a compact three-quarter view with a clear outer silhouette and no surrounding scene
finish: Build the form from a few translucent, overlapping pigment washes; keep soft blooms, granulation, and occasional dry-brush paper flecks inside the painted shape, with slightly pooled edges and only a faint grounding wash
palette: Dusty denim or slate blue carries the main form; warm ochre marks one or two key parts, with cream paper left visible as highlights

name: Yarn
form: Recognizable cozy object built from thick stitched pieces and sewn-on small details, three-quarter view
finish: Individual yarn loops and cable-knit ridges visible throughout, soft wool fibers, gentle warm lighting
palette: Muted sage green, oatmeal cream, chestnut brown, and tiny burnt-orange stitches

name: Sketchy
form: One isolated, immediately recognizable everyday object with a chunky rounded silhouette, mostly side-on or gently tilted
finish: Thick smooth slightly wobbly black marker contour, large flat solid color regions, only a few simple interior lines and tiny white shine marks; no shading or texture
palette: Turquoise-cyan is the dominant fill; coral pink is the secondary fill; vivid blue is a small third color; black contours stay consistent

name: Pulse
description: Geometric flat vector with offset depth
form: Office or utility object assembled from broad straight-edged color panels, mostly frontal
finish: Matte solid fill, no contour stroke, one dark navy offset side face, zero texture
palette: Indigo-periwinkle dominates, dusty sage green secondary, coral-orange and mustard-yellow small panels, deep navy depth

name: Candypop
form: Single plump candy or playful confection with an inflated rounded silhouette, simple front or shallow three-quarter view
finish: Smooth hard-candy lacquer, a few broad crisp white highlights and a soft luminous rim; clean molded surfaces
palette: Hot pink and magenta dominate, with bold cyan, royal blue, violet or yellow in two or three large color patches

name: Charcoal
form: Familiar household object with believable form and slightly uneven dark contours, three-quarter view
finish: Dense visible pencil strokes following form, gray-blue hatching, soft paper-grain shadows
palette: Slate and denim blue-gray dominate, cream highlights, small dusty salmon or pale gold accents

name: Ceramic
form: Single rounded home-decor object with a simple, softly molded silhouette, front or shallow three-quarter view
finish: Smooth glossy porcelain glaze, broad gentle highlights, softly modeled volume, hand-shaped edges and one or two restrained raised relief details
palette: Blush pink is dominant; pale aqua or mint marks one inset or secondary part; lavender, cream and tiny warm yellow accents

name: Fuzzy
form: Compact soft object with a puffy but precise silhouette, near-front view
finish: Dense velvety microfibers over every surface, rounded seams and appliqued details, soft diffuse light
palette: Hot pink main body, lavender secondary, baby-blue panels, tiny peach details

name: Colorcut
form: One small compact pictogram built from two to five rounded, irregular interlocking color shapes, front-facing without perspective
finish: Mostly flat digital fills, softly blended overlap edges, occasional clipped edge, hole or inset; no physical paper texture, stroke or grounding shadow
palette: Bright cobalt, leaf green, vermilion, pink, orange and pale lime; limit each glyph to two or three hues

name: Hologram
form: Compact floating icon built from a handful of broad beveled planes, subtly tilted in three-quarter view, small clear silhouette and faint ground shadow
finish: Crisp facet boundaries with restrained cyan-lavender-peach-gold refraction on selected faces, narrow pale edge glints, only occasional pin-size star glint; light from above-left
palette: Powder cyan and lavender dominate, with blush-peach and small golden reflections over very pale mint

name: Nightfall
form: Small tilted or floating vignette on a solid deep-slate field; one expressive subject with no more than one related prop or motion flourish
finish: Rounded softly beveled shapes, restrained hand-painted gradients and very light pigment grain, gentle upper-left light; sparse cloud fragments or tiny sparkles
palette: Coral-peach, pale sky blue, grass green, warm orange and sunflower yellow against dark blue-charcoal #2B424A

name: Storyworld
form: One purposeful architectural hero on a small square or diamond plinth with visible top and thick angular sides; precise consistent 30-degree isometric view
finish: Clean crisp vector facets and angular steps, sharply defined compact platform shadow, rare gradients on selected planes, deep navy openings with a few tiny stars
palette: Cobalt and violet structures, warm yellow planes, coral and mint accents, navy cavities against generous warm-white space
